حصير: Woven plant mat, with roughness/skin-side impression explained; no added back/two-side inside canonical scene.
وطاء: Soft bedding offered by companions, not the Prophet ordering it.
راكب: Rider/traveller; exact published VI horse explicitness preserved without claiming new horse-specific Arabic narration.
ما لي وللدنيا: Detachment from worldly affection, not ban on necessary worldly things.
shade: Actual benefit toward destination and then departure without attachment.
